summary: Winnebago Industries filed an 8-K on August 20, 2026, reporting entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement among the company, Winnebago of Indiana, Grand Design RV, and Newmar as borrowers, with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The new facility replaces a $350 million five-year asset-based revolver, extends maturity to August 20, 2031, and adds reporting and covenant modifications. Borrowings are secured by substantially all assets and limited by a borrowing base of eligible receivables and inventory; pricing is SOFR or REVSOFR30 plus 1.25%-1.75% and a 0.25% commitment fee. No borrowings are outstanding. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
